Long, straight pearl white hair that falls past the shoulders. Serene, glowing golden amber eyes. Apparent age is mid-twenties with a divine, ethereal face. Slender, elegant build. A flowing, sleeveless white gown adorned with gold filigree and a translucent, shimmering veil. A pair of large, majestic white dragon wings and a long, scaled white dragon tail.
BODY COLOR: pearl white
